parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Resolve parallel or perpendicular to plane with three terms; allow sign errors, sine/cosine mix or missing $g$; forces needing resolution must be resolved and forces not needing resolution must not be.
A1: $R=P\sin35^\circ+0.6g\cos35^\circ$, with $R=(0.573...)P+4.914...$.
A1: $F+P\cos35^\circ=0.6g\sin35^\circ$, with $F+(0.819...)P=3.441...$; their $F$.
*M1: Use $F=0.4R$, where $R$ is initially a linear combination of a $P$ component and weight/mass component.
DM1: Solve for $P$ from equations with the correct number of relevant resolved terms. $R=0.6g/(\cos35^\circ+0.4\sin35^\circ)=5.7222$. Must get to $P=...$, e.g. $P=(0.6g\sin35^\circ-0.4\times0.6g\cos35^\circ)/(\cos35^\circ+0.4\sin35^\circ)$. If no working is shown, allow this mark for a correct solution of their equations. If $F\le0.4R$ is used, it must be used correctly; the official populated inequality route is $0.6g\sin35^\circ-P\cos35^\circ\le0.4(P\sin35^\circ+0.6g\cos35^\circ)$.
A1: $P=1.41$ N, awrt 1.41. If $P\ge1.41$ is seen, explicitly state the least value.
Alternative resolving vertically/horizontally: *M1 three terms with the same allowances; A1 $R\cos35^\circ+F\sin35^\circ=0.6g$; A1 $P+F\cos35^\circ=R\sin35^\circ$; *M1 use $F=0.4R$ to obtain two equations, one in $R$ (or $F$) and one in $P$ and $R$ (or $P$ and $F$), allow missing $g$; DM1 solve, with the same populated $R$ and $P$ expressions and no-working allowance; A1 $P=1.41$ N, awrt 1.41.
Printed total: 6.
